cards.example_en: It was wise to leave early.
cards.example_zh: 早点离开是明智的。

cards.example_en: I wish the rain would stop before the match.
cards.example_zh: 我希望雨在比赛开始前停下来。

cards.example_en: I went to the zoo with my dad.
cards.example_zh: 我和爸爸去了动物园。

cards.example_en: Please finish it within ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 请在十分钟内完成。

cards.example_en: Don't go out without a coat.
cards.example_zh: 出门不要不穿外套。

cards.example_en: The wolf howled on the hill.
cards.example_zh: 狼在山上嚎叫。

cards.example_en: A woman on the bus offered her seat to my grandma.
cards.example_zh: 公交车上，一位女人把座位让给了我奶奶。

cards.example_en: I wonder why the bakery is closed this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我想知道这家面包店今天下午为什么关门。

cards.example_en: We had a wonderful picnic by the river on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我们在河边野餐，玩得特别开心。

cards.example_en: Dad cut the wood for our new bookshelf last Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 上周六，爸爸锯了木头，准备做我们的新书架。

cards.example_en: I cannot read one word on the messy blackboard.
cards.example_zh: 黑板上太乱了，有一个单词我认不出来。

cards.example_en: My aunt will work at the hospital on night shifts.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨将在医院上夜班。

cards.example_en: A factory worker fixed the broken gate before dark.
cards.example_zh: 一名工厂工人在天黑前修好了坏掉的大门。

cards.example_en: Students from around the world joined our music festival.
cards.example_zh: 来自世界各地的学生参加了我们的音乐节。

cards.example_en: Don't worry about the test.
cards.example_zh: 不要担心测试。

cards.example_en: Today the pain is worse than yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 今天的疼痛比昨天更严重。

cards.example_en: That was the worst storm of the year.
cards.example_zh: 那是今年最严重的暴风雨。

cards.example_en: This old camera is worth more than I expected.
cards.example_zh: 这台旧相机比我预想的更值钱。

cards.example_en: Would you like a cup of tea?
cards.example_zh: 你想喝杯茶吗？

cards.example_en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
cards.example_zh: 护士清洗了伤口。

cards.example_en: Students write their names on the cover of the notebook.
cards.example_zh: 学生们把名字写在笔记本的封面上。

cards.example_en: I took the wrong train and arrived home late.
cards.example_zh: 我坐错了火车，回家晚了。

cards.example_en: The doctor checked the X-ray of his arm.
cards.example_zh: 医生查看了他手臂的X光片。

cards.example_en: The children played football in the yard after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们晚饭后在院子里踢足球。

cards.example_en: This year our school added a new swimming pool.
cards.example_zh: 今年我们学校新建了一个游泳池。

cards.example_en: The yellow leaves covered the path in the park.
cards.example_zh: 黄叶铺满了公园里的小路。

cards.example_en: Yes, I can help you with that.
cards.example_zh: 是的，我可以帮你。

cards.example_en: Yesterday was rainy, so the football match moved indoors.
cards.example_zh: 昨天一直下雨，所以足球赛改到了室内。

cards.example_en: Have you finished your homework yet?
cards.example_zh: 你做完作业了吗？

cards.example_en: I chose yogurt instead of milk with my breakfast toast.
cards.example_zh: 早餐吃吐司时，我选了酸奶而不是牛奶。

cards.example_en: You can sit next to me.
cards.example_zh: 你可以坐在我旁边。

cards.example_en: My young cousin just started primary school this year.
cards.example_zh: 我的小表弟今年刚上小学。

cards.example_en: Is this your new bicycle?
cards.example_zh: 这是你的新自行车吗？

cards.example_en: Is this pencil yours?
cards.example_zh: 这支铅笔是你的吗？

cards.example_en: Did you make this cake yourself?
cards.example_zh: 这个蛋糕是你自己做的吗？

cards.example_en: The local youth meet in the gym on Saturday afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 当地青年每周六下午在体育馆聚会。

cards.example_en: The score was zero to zero.
cards.example_zh: 比分是零比零。

cards.example_en: The class visited the zoo on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 周五全班去了动物园。

cards.example_en: The library stays closed on Monday because of staff training.
cards.example_zh: 因为员工培训，图书馆星期一不开放。

cards.example_en: The science quiz is on Tuesday in room twelve.
cards.example_zh: 科学小测安排在周二，地点是十二号教室。

cards.example_en: Basketball practice moved to Wednesday because of the rain.
cards.example_zh: 因为下雨，篮球训练改到了周三。

cards.example_en: Thursday is match day for our school football team.
cards.example_zh: 星期四是我们学校足球队的比赛日。

cards.example_en: Choir practice moved to Friday because the hall was busy.
cards.example_zh: 因为大厅有活动，合唱练习改到了星期五。

cards.example_en: The street market is busiest on Saturday before noon.
cards.example_zh: 街头市场在周六中午之前最热闹。

cards.example_en: Sunday is quiet because our family stays at home.
cards.example_zh: 星期日很安静，因为我们全家都待在家里。

cards.example_en: Ice on the playground lasted through January this year.
cards.example_zh: 今年操场上的冰一直留到了一月底。

cards.example_en: The art show opens in February after the winter break.
cards.example_zh: 艺术展在寒假结束之后的二月开幕。

cards.example_en: Snow still covered the playground in early March this year.
cards.example_zh: 今年三月初，操场上还盖着雪。

cards.example_en: April rain kept the running track muddy for days.
cards.example_zh: 四月的雨让跑道一连泥泞了好几天。

cards.example_en: Exams finish in May, and then the sports meeting begins.
cards.example_zh: 考试在五月结束，接着运动会就开始了。

word.example_en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
Without doubt, she is our best runner.
word.example_zh: 毫无疑问，她是我们最好的赛跑选手。

word.example_en: In a word, the plan is too expensive.
word.example_zh: 简言之，这个计划太贵了。

word.example_en: My aunt is at work on Saturday.
People all over the world like football.
word.example_zh: 全世界的人都喜欢足球。

word.example_en: I would like to order a bowl of noodles.
I write to my cousin once a month.
word.example_zh: 我每个月给表弟写一封信。

word.example_en: Something may go wrong with the printer.
Year after year, the tree grows taller.
word.example_zh: 年复一年，树长得更高了。

word.example_en: I saw her the day before yesterday.
